## Description
Please include a summary of the changes, the rationale behind them, and which issue or roadmap item is resolved.

Fixes / Closes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Architectural enhancement / refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security / compliance hardening

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards and style conventions (`ruff check .`).
- [ ] I have added type annotations and verified with `mypy continuous_legal_memory`.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works offline.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`pytest tests/unit`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Multi-tenant isolation and bitemporal constraints are strictly preserved.
